alt: Hundreds of costumed zombies packed into a London street, photographed from above — a bride with rabbit ears, a deep-sea diving helmet, top hats and hospital scrubs among them.
A zombie in a bowler hat carries a megaphone and the World Zombie Day: London banner through Leicester Square, with the walk following behind.
slot: home — what happens on the day

alt: Zombies of all ages wait at the kerb — a steward holding a Zombies Crossing sign, a parent in scrubs with a small child in costume, and a zombie holding a yellow “Danger: beware of zombies” sign.
Several hundred zombies fill the graffiti-covered Leake Street tunnel, waiting for the walk to move off.
A steward in a blood-spattered high-vis vest holds a hand-painted “Zombies Crossing” lollipop sign while the walk waits behind him.
A French bulldog wearing a brain-print cap and a rib-cage harness stands on a paved street.
Zombies shamble past a sponsor’s red kissing-booth tent, one of them carrying a small dog and another holding a bunch of flowers.
Two zombies with lollipops in their mouths take a selfie against a brightly painted graffiti wall.
Two zombies in heavy prosthetic make-up pose beneath the London Eye, backlit by the low sun.
A zombie in glasses, half her face made up as raw flesh, reaches towards the camera with more zombies out of focus behind her.
Two zombies pose cheek to cheek in the street, one wearing a prop road sign speared through the head.
A zombie tilts his head back while a friend with purple hair drips fake blood onto his face from a bottle.
A zombie in a gingham dress clutches a blood-stained teddy bear and reaches towards the camera.
A zombie bride in a pink lace dress holds a snarling wolf puppet, another participant standing behind her.
Two zombies shelter under a pink umbrella in the rain at Piccadilly Circus at night, beside a London Underground sign.
Two zombies grimace beneath a hand-painted “Zombies” crossing sign held above them.
A group of zombies advances towards the camera past a cluster of red balloons, one man caught mid-groan.
